nodes.title: Features
nodes.heading: What you can do with ModulaCMS
nodes.subheading: Start with a REST API. Enable what you need. Nothing more.

nodes.title: Single Binary
nodes.description: No runtime dependencies. No Node.js, no npm, no package manager. Download and run.

nodes.title: User-Defined Datatypes
nodes.description: Posts, products, calendars, quizzes — all first-class datatypes. Not custom post types bolted onto a blog engine.

nodes.title: SSH TUI
nodes.description: Manage content, configure schema, run database operations — all from your terminal over SSH.

nodes.title: Multi-Format API
nodes.description: Output compatible with Contentful, Sanity, Strapi, WordPress, or clean JSON. Migrate without rewriting your frontend.

nodes.title: Independent Admin Panel
nodes.description: Admin UI is configured separately from content schema. Change how editors see content without touching the data model.

nodes.title: Built-in SSL
nodes.description: Self-signed certs for local development, Let's Encrypt for production. No reverse proxy config needed.

nodes.title: Contentful / Sanity
nodes.pain_point: Usage caps, per-user pricing, cloud lock-in. Contentful: 5 users, 25K records free. Sanity: 3 users, 500K API calls/month.
nodes.modulacms_answer: Free, self-hosted, no usage caps. All features, no limits, no upgrade prompts.

nodes.title: Payload
nodes.pain_point: Features gated behind enterprise pricing. Node.js runtime required. Acquired by Figma — product direction uncertain.
nodes.modulacms_answer: No paid tiers. Single binary, no runtime. SSH TUI for terminal management. Independent, community-driven.

nodes.title: Strapi
nodes.pain_point: Node.js process with runtime dependencies. Plugin ecosystem adds complexity.
nodes.modulacms_answer: Single binary vs Node.js process. Go performance. No package manager, no dependency chain.

nodes.title: WordPress
nodes.pain_point: Heavy ACF usage causes 30+ joins per query through wp_postmeta. Custom post types bolted onto a blog engine. No horizontal scaling.
nodes.modulacms_answer: Dedicated content tables with proper relationships. Datatypes designed for complex content from day one. Stateless binary scales behind a load balancer.

nodes.title: CTA
nodes.heading: All features. One binary. Free forever.
nodes.subheading: No tiers, no cloud lock-in, no upgrade prompts. Ever.

GET /api/v1/routes/docs/cli?format=clean.description: Every command, flags, and exit codes.

nodes.title: serve
nodes.description: Starts the ModulaCMS server. On first run, auto-creates default config and initializes SQLite database.
nodes.flags:
--wizard  Interactive setup for database, S3, OAuth, SSL
--port    HTTP port (default: 8080)
--tls-port HTTPS port (default: 8443)
--config  Path to config file (default: ./config.json)
nodes.examples:
modulacms serve
modulacms serve --wizard
modulacms serve --port 3000 --config /etc/modulacms/config.json
nodes.exit_codes:
0 — clean shutdown
1 — config error
2 — database connection failed
3 — port already in use

nodes.title: db init
nodes.description: Creates all required ModulaCMS tables in the configured database. Safe to run multiple times — skips existing tables.
nodes.examples:
modulacms db init
modulacms db init --config /etc/modulacms/config.json
nodes.exit_codes:
0 — tables created or already exist
1 — config error
2 — database connection failed

nodes.title: db backup
nodes.description: Creates a backup of the current database. SQLite: file copy. PostgreSQL/MySQL: pg_dump/mysqldump.
nodes.flags:
--output  Backup file path (default: ./backups/{timestamp}.sql)
--config  Path to config file
nodes.examples:
modulacms db backup
modulacms db backup --output /backups/pre-migration.sql
nodes.exit_codes:
0 — backup created
1 — config error
2 — database connection failed
3 — write permission denied

nodes.title: Multi-Format API Output
nodes.body: API responses can now be transformed to match Contentful, Sanity, Strapi, or WordPress formats. Add ?format=contentful to any content endpoint.
